verdict.rationale: The evidence documents stream/property selection and incremental replication state tracking, so runs resume where they left off. Neither is a documented way to backfill history or force a full resync of one table: there is no evidence of a full-refresh flag, per-stream state reset, or targeted backfill command. Stream selection and state tracking are adjacent building blocks, not the capability itself.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can backfill history or resync a single table without rebuilding the whole pipeline
